baseline.coverage: prepared projection only; native activation remains unverified

coverage.proves: Within the bounded AST grammar, reachable literal assertions exercise the public consumer against the accepted samples and reject the specified identity and wrong-delta consumer mutations. Source and contract bytes remain unchanged; sufficient control tests remain byte-identical.
coverage.does_not_prove: Tests executed, a real device or test runner behaved correctly, arbitrary defects are detected, the model actually reasoned independently, or internal capabilities activated.

correctness.proves: Correct literal consumer assertions pass; helper-only, mirrored, wrong-expectation, disconnected-test, changed-contract and control-rewrite mutations are distinguished.
correctness.does_not_prove: The checker is complete for arbitrary tests or arbitrary consumer implementations.

coverage.proves: Grades the final finite JSON answer and validates every preceding completed message as a fixed progress-only frame; detects synthetic marker disclosure in all emitted message updates, finite false findings, surplus questions and unrequested procedure outputs.
coverage.does-not-prove: Does not prove real external actions, remote privacy, internal capability activation, actual operations named by progress frames, unrestricted natural-language quality or runtime behavior. Free-form progress is unassessed and blocks completion.
prerequisites: zero or more fixed progress-only frames followed by one strict finite JSON answer

correctness.proves: Accepts correct finite answers with optional fixed progress frames; rejects free prose, earlier answers and unknown progress fields while preserving known disclosures.
correctness.does-not-prove: Calibration does not establish completeness for arbitrary tasks or host streams.
